prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Looking for React Native developer
We are looking for an experienced React Native developer to assist us in maintaining our e-commerce app and enhancing the app with new functionality and new UI/UX. You can access our source code and review the task before you start work
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Write 300 to 380 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working developer who enjoys building and improving products that need both strong functionality and a smooth user experience.

I have 7 years of experience working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack development, HTML, and CSS. While my core background is in modern web development, I’m very comfortable working in codebases where reliability, maintainability, and clean UI implementation matter most. I also enjoy stepping into existing source code, understanding the structure quickly, and making thoughtful improvements without disrupting what already works.

For your React Native e-commerce app, I can help maintain the current product, review the source code carefully, and contribute to new functionality as well as UI/UX updates. Since you mentioned that I can access the code and review tasks before starting, that is exactly the kind of workflow I prefer. It allows me to assess the scope properly, identify the best approach, and ensure the work is aligned with your goals before implementation begins.

I’m especially interested in projects where the app needs both ongoing maintenance and meaningful product improvements. Whether that means refining screens, improving user flows, adding new features, or helping clean up and stabilize existing functionality, I can bring a practical and detail-oriented approach. I value clear communication, consistent progress, and writing code that is straightforward to maintain over time.

If you’re looking for someone who can work carefully within an existing app, collaborate on enhancements, and help move the product forward with a strong focus on quality, I’d be glad to discuss the role further.

What is the first task you’d like me to review in the source code?
